findings.title: Document has an empty <title> element
findings.description: axe-core (Tier 2, rendered page): document-title violation. The <title> element is empty, so screen reader users and browser tabs get no page identification.
findings.fix: Set the WordPress site title / SEO title so the homepage renders e.g. <title>亞太包容創新協會 APAC AIA</title>.

findings.title: Header logo link has no accessible name
findings.description: axe-core: link-name violation. The logo <a class="brand has-logo-image" rel="home"> is in the tab order but contains no text, aria-label, or image alt — screen readers announce it as an unnamed link.
findings.fix: Add alt="亞太包容創新協會 首頁" to the logo image, or aria-label on the anchor.

findings.title: Primary CTA 「了解志工機會」 is a non-interactive <span>, unreachable by keyboard
findings.description: The Kadence button block has no link URL set, so it renders as <span class="kb-button kt-button"> with cursor:pointer styling only — no href, no role, no tabindex. Keyboard users cannot reach it and screen readers do not expose it as interactive. Verified in the rendered DOM and the accessibility tree (exposed as 'generic', not link/button).
findings.fix: Set the button's link target in the Kadence block settings so it renders as 了解志工機會.

findings.title: Primary navigation link contrast 4.16:1 (below 4.5:1)
findings.description: axe-core computed contrast: foreground #4a5568 on background #e4bc54 = 4.16:1 at 17px normal weight. Below the AA 4.5:1 minimum for normal text.
findings.fix: Per the AIA brand contrast matrix, use Navy #003B5C on Golden Yellow #F8B62D (6.58:1) or Near Black #231815 on Gold (9.66:1).

findings.title: CTA button text contrast 3.54:1 (below 4.5:1)
findings.description: axe-core computed contrast: #ffffff on #e8593a = 3.54:1 at 18px normal weight. Below the AA 4.5:1 minimum. #e8593a is also outside the AIA brand palette.
findings.fix: Use the brand CTA pattern: Golden Yellow #F8B62D background with Near Black #231815 text (9.66:1, AAA).

findings.title: Footer social links (Facebook / X / Instagram) have empty href
findings.description: Three named social links point to href="" (reloads current page). Placeholder links that go nowhere confuse all users; screen reader users hear a valid link with no destination.
findings.fix: Fill in the real profile URLs, or remove the icons until the profiles exist.
